name: Catan
description: Settle an island, trade resources, and race to 10 victory points.

name: Ticket to Ride
description: Collect train cards and claim routes to connect cities across the map.

name: Carcassonne
description: Place tiles to build a medieval landscape and put followers on it to score points.

name: Pandemic
description: Work as a team to treat diseases and find cures before outbreaks overwhelm the world.

name: Codenames
description: Two teams of spies give one-word clues to find their agents on a grid of words.

name: Azul
description: Draft colorful tiles to decorate a palace wall and score patterns.

name: Wingspan
description: Attract birds to your wildlife preserve and build an engine out of card combos.

name: Splendor
description: Collect gems, buy mines, and attract nobles as a Renaissance merchant.

name: 7 Wonders
description: Draft cards over three ages to build an ancient civilization and its wonder.

name: Dominion
description: Build your own deck of cards as the game goes on, in the original deck-building game.

name: Agricola
description: Raise a family and build a farm while balancing food, animals, and crops.

name: Scythe
description: Lead a faction in an alternate 1920s Europe by gathering resources and claiming territory.

name: Terraforming Mars
description: Compete as corporations to make Mars livable by raising its temperature, oxygen, and oceans.

name: Gloomhaven
description: A cooperative tactical dungeon crawl with a long campaign and card-based combat.

name: Everdell
description: Build a woodland city of critters and constructions across the seasons.

name: Cascadia
description: Draft tiles and wildlife tokens to build a natural habitat and score patterns.

name: Sushi Go!
description: Pass hands of sushi cards around the table and pick the best combinations.

name: Just One
description: A cooperative word-guessing game where players write clues, but duplicate clues get erased.

name: Exploding Kittens
designer: Elan Lee, Matthew Inman, and Shane Small
description: Draw cards and try not to pull an exploding kitten, using sabotage cards to survive.

name: Coup
description: Bluff your way through a game of hidden influence cards, and the last player standing wins.

name: The Resistance
description: Hidden roles pit a resistance against secret spies through team votes and missions.

name: Love Letter
description: Get a letter to the princess using a tiny deck of sixteen cards and a lot of deduction.

name: King of Tokyo
description: Giant monsters roll dice to attack, heal, and collect points in a city smash-up.

name: Dixit
description: Players give clues for illustrated cards, and everyone guesses which card belongs to the storyteller.

name: Takenoko
description: Tend a bamboo garden and feed a panda while completing objective cards.

name: Patchwork
description: Two players buy fabric patches to fill a quilt board before running out of buttons.

name: Kingdomino
description: Draft domino-style tiles to grow a kingdom with matching terrain.

name: Risk
description: Conquer the world by rolling dice to attack and defend territories.

name: Clue
description: Solve a murder mystery by deducing who did it, with what, and where.

name: Scrabble
description: Build crisscross words on a board and score points with letter and bonus squares.
